comparison.objective: Open binder rings, thread a divider, and reclose them; unlike tuning and locking a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual ring actuation and six-hole alignment/insertion. It lacks iterative dynamic-response adjustment and torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Open rings, release the divider on all six rings, then close them. No numeric tolerances or spec versions are supplied.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual manipulation is generic; the tested insertion and latching ability is meaningfully different.
